name: PixelStamp Watermark
author: Hussnain Ahmed

sections.description:
PixelStamp Watermark is an image protection and watermarking solution for WordPress. It allows you to protect your creative work with fully customizable text watermarks. You can watermark images automatically upon upload or process your entire media library in bulk.

With its native WordPress interface, PixelStamp Watermark integrates seamlessly into your workflow. It uses a non-destructive approach by creating secure backups of your original files, allowing you to restore them with a single click.

Features

  • Automatic watermarking on upload
  • Bulk watermark processing
  • Original image backup and restore
  • Real-time watermark preview
  • Multi-line text support
  • Rotation, spacing, and scale controls
  • JPEG, PNG, and WebP support
  • WordPress-native interface

Author

Hussnain Ahmed
sections.installation:
1. Upload the pixelstamp-watermark folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the ‘PixelStamp’ menu in your dashboard to configure your settings.
sections.faq:
Does it modify the original image?

It creates a secure backup of the original image before applying any watermark, so you can restore your original high-quality file anytime.

Can I watermark new uploads automatically?

Yes! Simply enable the “Auto-apply on upload” setting in the Global Settings sidebar, and every new image you upload will be protected automatically.

Which image formats are supported?

PixelStamp Watermark supports JPEG, PNG, and WebP formats.
